Name: Real Soccer 2013
Description: Gameloft's football game, with club competitions and online matches.

Achievements.Name: Natural-Born Winner
Achievements.Description: Win your first match

Achievements.Name: Poor Goalkeeper!
Achievements.Description: Score 5 goals or more in a single game

Achievements.Name: Hat-Trick
Achievements.Description: Score 3 goals in the same match with the same player

Achievements.Name: Top Scorer
Achievements.Description: Score 25 goals in the same tournament with the same player

Achievements.Name: Cold Blood
Achievements.Description: Win one match on penalties

Achievements.Name: Late Victory
Achievements.Description: Win one match in extra time

Achievements.Name: Just Started and Already Over
Achievements.Description: Score 3 goals in the first 30 minutes of a match

Achievements.Name: Living on the Edge
Achievements.Description: Get 5 yellow cards and no red cards in the same match

Achievements.Name: Assist Man
Achievements.Description: Rack up 25 assists in the same tournament with the same player

Achievements.Name: Great Save!
Achievements.Description: Save a penalty kick

Achievements.Name: You Now Own a City
Achievements.Description: Max out all buildings

Achievements.Name: Veni, Vidi, Vici
Achievements.Description: Meet a sponsor's target

Achievements.Name: Great Finish
Achievements.Description: Score two goals in the last 20 minutes of a match

Achievements.Name: Comeback
Achievements.Description: Avoid being defeated after going down 3-0 in match

Achievements.Name: Long-Term Comeback
Achievements.Description: Pass the turn in a two-leg match after having lost the first match

Achievements.Name: One for All, All for One
Achievements.Description: Score with 5 different players in the same match

Achievements.Name: Tiki-Taka
Achievements.Description: Have 70% possession of the ball in a single match

Achievements.Name: The Specialist
Achievements.Description: Score directly from a free kick

Achievements.Name: Unbeatable
Achievements.Description: Remain undefeated in a league schedule of 30 matches or more

Achievements.Name: Legendary Player
Achievements.Description: Win all the trophies and achievements
